description: This file contains C source code implementing functions related to analyzing and manipulating Git trees, including scoring tree similarity, filling tree descriptions from the repository, comparing trees, and shifting trees for merging purposes.

methods.name: int score_missing(unsigned mode)
methods.description: Calculates the score for a missing tree entry based on its mode, penalizing directories and symbolic links more heavily.

methods.name: int score_differs(unsigned mode1,unsigned mode2)
methods.description: Returns a score reflecting how different two tree entry modes are, penalizing differences especially in directory or link status.

methods.name: int score_matches(unsigned mode1,unsigned mode2)
methods.description: Returns a high score for matching entries and penalizes mode discrepancies, with special handling for directories and symbolic links.

methods.name: void * fill_tree_desc_strict(struct repository * r,struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * hash)
methods.description: Reads a tree object from the repository and initializes a tree description structure, used internally for tree comparison.

methods.name: int score_trees(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * hash1,const struct object_id * hash2)
methods.description: Compares two tree objects by their entries and computes a similarity score based on matching, missing, or differing entries.

methods.name: void match_trees(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * hash1,const struct object_id * hash2,int * best_score,char ** best_match,const char * base,int recurse_limit)
methods.description: Recursively matches subtrees between two trees, updating the best match score and path based on subtree similarity.

methods.name: int splice_tree(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid1,const char * prefix,const struct object_id * oid2,struct object_id * result)
methods.description: Replaces a subdirectory within a tree with another tree object, effectively merging or modifying parts of a tree.

methods.name: void shift_tree(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * hash1,const struct object_id * hash2,struct object_id * shifted,int depth_limit)
methods.description: Attempts to align one tree with another by shifting its subtrees, used for merging trees with different structures.

methods.name: void shift_tree_by(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * hash1,const struct object_id * hash2,struct object_id * shifted,const char * shift_prefix)
methods.description: Shifts a tree by a specified prefix, either to prefix or remove the prefix, to facilitate merging operations.

methods.name: int base_name_entries_compare(const struct name_entry * a,const struct name_entry * b)
